title: nan
authors: Yao F.; Lan C.; Wang L.; Wan H.; Gao T.; Wei Z.
key_contribution: Presents a UAV visual localization system for GNSS-denied environments integrating image matching, visual odometry, and terrain-weighted constraint optimization, validated in twenty experiments including night conditions.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
